Name: Birthday Notifications
Author: Honduriel
Description:
[size=5]Get notified on wakeup when it's someones birthday![/size]

[size=5]Installation
[/size][size=3]Unzip the file downloaded to "\%%SteamLibrary%%\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\".[/size]

[size=5]How to use the mod:
[/size][size=3]
Navigate to "\%%SteamLibrary%%\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\SVM_BirthdayNotifications" and open "config.json". The default file should look like this:

[code]﻿{
  "NotifyUnknownNPCs": false,
  "RecommendGift": true,
  "DatableNPCsOnly": false,
  "MinimumFriendshipHeartLevel": 1,
  "MinimumFriendshipHeartLevelForGifts": 2,
  "ExcludedNPCs": []
}
[/code]
With these setting you will get notifications if you met the person and have at least one heart of friendship. At 2 hearts you will also get a recommendation for a gift. This seemed like the most natural way to set it up.[/size]

[size=4]Chose whether to get notified even if you didn't meet the person yet:[/size]
[code]"NotifyUnknownNPCs": false,
[/code][list]
[*][size=3]Possible values: false or true.[/size]
[*][size=3]Default value is false.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Chose whether or not to get a gift recommendation:[/size]
[code]﻿"RecommendGift": false,[/code][list]
[*][size=3]Possible values: false or true.[/size]
[*][size=3]Default value is false.[/size]
[/list]

[size=4]Chose between notifications for all NPCs or just those you can date:[/size]
[code]﻿"DatableNPCsOnly": false,[/code][list]
[*][size=3]Possible values: false or true.[/size]
[*][size=3]Default value is false.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Chose a minimum friendship level to get notifications:[/size]
[code]﻿"MinimumFriendshipHeartLevel": 1,[/code][list]
[*][size=3]Possible values: Between 0 and 10. 0 equals "Always notify".[/size]
[*][size=3]Default value is 1.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Chose a minimum friendship level to get gift recommendations:[/size]
[code]﻿"MinimumFriendshipHeartLevelForGifts": 2,[/code][list]
[*][size=3]Possible values: Between 0 and 10. 0 equals "Always notify".[/size]
[*][size=3]Default value is 2.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Exclude NPCs to not get notifications for their birthday:[/size]
[code]﻿"ExcludedNPCs": ["Haley", "Alex"],[/code][list]
[*][size=3]Possible values: See example above, write names in quotation marks inside the squared brackets, separated by commas.[/size]
[*][size=3]Default value is empty (Don't exclude any notifications)[/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
- Fixed a bug where the game crashed if no NPC had a birthday that day
- Added nexusmods as mirror, updates about new version should work now
- Added config.json so it can be modified without starting the game first
